ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters. Estimated macro ratio of ~85% low-intensity to ~15% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular spots (rosettes) and linear streaks (scratches) mapped across a dark continuous field. Higher density of light-pixel mapping observed on the medial and distal sections of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel-based interior angle of approximately 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitude variations between 5 and 15 pixels. Significant jagged protrusions on distal tips corresponding to biological growth.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (white on black); vertical and diagonal rake marks are most prominent on the right lobe, crossing the central horizontal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of white, high-relief barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Extensive parallel rake marks (likely predatory interaction) on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible organic mass (brownish-gray texture) adhered to the right distal tip, causing a significant break in the geometric contour of the lobe.
